name: AVERROES
group: Apixaban vs Aspirin in AF unsuitable for VKA (NEJM 2011)
robSource: Connolly 2011 NEJM: randomised, double-blind, double-dummy, independent blinded endpoint adjudication
snippet: AVERROES NCT00496769: Connolly SJ et al. NEJM 2011;364:806-817. 5,599 AF patients unsuitable for vitamin K antagonist, apixaban 5mg BID (n=2808) vs aspirin 81-324mg (n=2791). Stroke/SE: 51 vs 113 (HR 0.45 [0.32-0.62], p<0.001). All-cause death 111 vs 140 (HR 0.79) cross-verified against AACT results. Trial stopped early for efficacy.

evidence.label: Enrollment & Design
evidence.text: 5,599 patients with AF unsuitable for VKA randomised 1:1. Apixaban 5mg BID (n=2808) vs aspirin 81-324mg/day (n=2791). Mean CHADS2=2.0. Stopped early for efficacy at mean follow-up 1.1yr.

evidence.label: Primary: Stroke or SE
evidence.text: Stroke or systemic embolism: 51/2808 (1.6%/yr) apixaban vs 113/2791 (3.7%/yr) aspirin. HR 0.45 (95% CI 0.32-0.62), p<0.001. Major bleeding similar (HR 1.13, CI 0.74-1.75).
